_doc: Heroes' ability score improvements (Systems/Advances.cs): at each of levels (and a class's extra levels) a hero raises their key ability by 2 (to cap) while it is under keyBelow, then takes the first feat that fits them and they lack, else raises Constitution. Feats: classes or cards limit who takes them; hpPerLevel adds to hit points, attack/ac/skill to rolls in delves, initiative to the order in fights, concentration to holding a spell when struck.
